examples.english: Since friends were coming, I set plates and cups on the table to get ready.

notes:
テーブル (from English "table") refers to Western-style tables with legs. For low Japanese-style tables used while sitting on the floor, use ⟦{卓袱台|ちゃぶだい}→卓袱台：06229_chabudai⟧ or こたつ (heated table).

Common types:
- ⟦ダイニングテーブル→ダイニングテーブル：noentry⟧ (dining table)
- ⟦ローテーブル→ローテーブル：noentry⟧ (coffee table)
- ⟦サイドテーブル→サイドテーブル：noentry⟧ (side table)
- ⟦{折|お}→折る：01263_oru⟧りたたみテーブル (folding table)

Common expressions:
- テーブル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：noentry⟧ (gather around the table)
- テーブル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧ (take a seat at the table)
- ⟦テーブルマナー→テーブルマナー：noentry⟧ (table manners)
